title: Tum Na Laut Kar Aye
body:
Tum Na Laut Kar Aye Eid Agayi Baba,
Hogayi Sugra Se Dur Har Khushi Baba..
1) Roz Qabr Ki Janib Ek Kadam Badhati Hu,
Dheere Dheere Hoti Hai Khatm Zindagi Baba..
2) Mujh Mein Ab Nahi Takat Ek Diya Jalane Ki,
Chaand Aake Karta Hai Ghar Main Roshni Baba..
3) Ane Jane Walo Ko Roz Rasta Takti Hu,
Koun De Khabar Lakar Mujhko Ap Ki Baba..
4) Dub'ta Hai Jab Suraj Dil Gurub Hota Hai,
Mera Nawha Padti Hai Meri Bekasi Baba..
5) Bhai Ho Ya Behne Ho Maa Ho Ya Phuppi Zainab,
Hai Dua Ke Bin Mere Khus Rahe Sabhi Baba..
6) Wo Sakina Aur Kubra Rakkhe Bas Khayal Ayese,
Ap Ko Na Mehsus Ho Meri Kuch Kami Baba..
7) Qabr Par Meri Ana Leke Mere Ashgar Ko,
Lout Kar Madine Mein Aau Jab Kabhi Baba..
8) Kehti Thi Taqallum Wo kaash TumKo Dekhu Main,
Chal Rahi Hain Sughra Ki Saan's Aakhri Baba..
